subject: Case Assignment
Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: The pair is a HARD_CONFLICT when both candidates share an affected activity.
contradictions.measured_said: Both candidates were applied successfully and Phase 3 built a legal model despite sharing A_CANCELLED.
evidence: get_pair_relation reported condition_fires=true with shared activity A_CANCELLED
Phase 3 outcome: CA-002 applied=true and NI-001 applied=true
Measured conflict at A_CANCELLED showed contention rising by 0.2928 h, z=5.47
contradictions.note: The pair can coexist structurally, although their shared-resource contention should remain a soft warning.

subject: Activity Elimination
contradictions.prior_said: Eliminating a non-value-adding step should strongly improve time.
evidence: AE-002 was applied successfully in Phase 3
The whole-plan mean throughput improved by 156.99 h/case, z=-88.4
contradictions.note: The strong positive time direction was supported.

subject: Activity Composition
contradictions.prior_said: Merging consecutive activities should weakly improve time by removing seams and handovers.
contradictions.measured_said: Both activity-composition candidates were applied and their sole-owned activity times improved.
evidence: AC-001 and AC-002 both succeeded in Phase 3
AC-001 sole-owned A_SUBMITTED time fell by 0.9445 h/case, z=-107.4
AC-002 sole-owned O_SENT time fell by 0.0228 h/case, z=-11.47
contradictions.note: The measured direction supports the prior.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact because assigning one case to one resource should reduce handover overhead.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-002 produced significant time harm and queueing increases, so the time effect is context-dependent rather than reliably positive.
evidence: CA-002 activity throughput worsened by 1.572 h/case (z=55.48)
CA-002 A_DECLINED waiting increased significantly (z=35.11), with similar contention at A_ACCEPTED (z=8.16), A_CANCELLED (z=18.20), and A_PREACCEPTED (z=18.66)
CA-001 and CA-003 were measured as helped, so the plan comparison shows heterogeneous Case Assignment effects rather than a universal reversal
contradictions.note: Revise the Case Assignment time prior to reflect strong dependence on pool composition and contention; do not treat Case Assignment as uniformly weak-positive.
